text:
Alice Chen: quick follow-up — we saw a small but consistent drift in FP8 outputs for the summarization workload after ~72h of steady traffic.
Ben Ortiz: curious, is that dataset shift or calibration state divergence?
Alice Chen: initial hunch: KV-cache amplification + tiny scale mismatch in layernorm stats after repeated prefix reuse. Not catastrophic but BLEU/ROUGE flicker.
Priya Nair: did you repro with the offline calibration harness or only in-prod telemetry?
Alice Chen: both. Offline run on a 5M-token holdout shows mean shift in softmax entropy; in-prod telemetry shows increased token perplexity on a subset of customers.
Marco Ruiz: can you paste the small repro snippet you used? I want to run it against int8 builds too.
Alice Chen: sure — minimal script we used:

```
# sample repro
python tools/quant_eval.py \
  --model=redwood/small-13b-fp8-cand \
  --calib-set=holdout_5M.jsonl \
  --batch=8 \
  --kv-prefix-reuse=2000 \
  --report=entropy,perp,topk
```

Alice Chen: config tweak that made the diff visible: kv-prefix-reuse and streaming=false.
Zoe Patel: interesting. For INT8 tests earlier we saw drift only when using per-shard calibration stats (not global aggregated stats).
Ben Ortiz: are we storing per-shard scale/zero params in the artifact? Or recomputing at load?
Priya Nair: current flow: compute per-shard calibration during conversion -> persist as part of quant artifact -> runtime loads as-is. There's a fallback to recompute on first load if blob missing.
Marco Ruiz: potential root cause: per-tenant sequence patterns cause different activation distributions; persisting a single stat per shard drifts when tenant workload changes.
Alice Chen: exactly — suggestion: bake a lightweight per-tenant delta correction on top of persisted stats. Think of it as a small scale offset vector applied to per-channel scales.
Zoe Patel: delta correction could be noisy. We can instead detect drift windows and trigger a rolling recalibration job for that shard with recent traffic sample.
Ben Ortiz: both approaches are viable. Tradeoffs:
- delta correction: low-latency, cheap, risk of overfitting to recent noise
- rolling recalib: more robust but heavier and needs sample retention + job orchestration
Priya Nair: also need safety net: when recalib job is running, serve using the last known-good profile and route a small fraction to recalib copy (canary) for eval.
runtime-bot: deploy-log: canary model quant-profile v2.1 deployed to shard-7 at 1723456800 — 1% traffic
Marco Ruiz: for orchestration we can reuse the existing canary job runner used by model rollouts (eng-platform). Minimal changes: a recalib pipeline that emits metric tags: quant:recalib, shard, tenant.
Alice Chen: telemetry needs: per-token entropy, topk-change, token-level logp delta; baseline window size 6h, alert if mean entropy change > 0.08.
Zoe Patel: that's fine. Need to ensure retention of sampled requests for recalib doesn't leak PII — apply scrubber and hash client ids before storage.
Ben Ortiz: implementation tasks:
1) add drift-detector hook in runtime to emit per-shard aggregated stats
2) pipeline to retain scrubbed sample windows in S3/GCS for recalib job
3) delta-correction prototype (small affine layer on per-channel scales)
4) canary/recalib orchestration + eval gating
Priya Nair: I'll take (1) and (2). Marco, you want to prototype delta-corr? Alice can help with eval harness.
Marco Ruiz: will do delta-corr POC. Target: perf overhead < 2% and quant error reduction >= 30% on repro cases.
Alice Chen: I'll run the evals and define pass/fail thresholds. Also will add a checklist for security review of sample retention.
Ben Ortiz: add an api contract note: quant-artifact v2 must carry optional metadata: "drift-anchor-checksum" and "calib-epoch". If missing, runtime should mark artifact as recompute-on-load.
Zoe Patel: agree. Also add a backward-compat flag so older artifacts still load without triggering alerts.
Priya Nair: timeline? can we prototype within sprint (2 weeks) for detector + sample retention? and delta-corr POC next sprint?
Alice Chen: yes — detector + retention first sprint. Marco will target delta-corr POC in sprint 2. I'll schedule a short demo next Tue.
Ben Ortiz: sounds good. Minor note: add unit tests that simulate sustained prefix reuse to trigger drift in CI.
Alice Chen: noted. Thanks all — I'll drop a short RFC follow-up doc with config knobs and a checklist.
Priya Nair: thanks. :thumbsup:
Zoe Patel: thanks — excited to see if delta-corr reduces the oscillations.
